title: The payer's Invoices tab names the service customer in Service For
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced for $210.00, billed to customer B, unpaid.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, invoiced, that bills itself.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A "Service For" column shows after No.
  • Work order 1's invoice reads customer A's name under Service For.
  • Work order 2's invoice, customer B's own work, is blank under Service For.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-R6: “The Bill To's Invoices tab shows a "Service For" column naming the customer the work was for.”
  • S10-R7: “The column is blank on rows billed to this customer for its own work.”
